tips: Prioritize Reels as your main content format, as they perform nearly 10x better than photo posts and breaking text alerts.
Write more content in Urdu (UR) rather than English (EN), as Urdu posts consistently achieve higher relative engagement (0.52 vs 0.32).
Focus heavily on Science/Tech and Business stories, particularly those involving major tech figures or economy-impacting global events.
Schedule posts strictly during peak window between 11:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC; completely avoid low-performing slots between 02:00 UTC and 09:00 UTC.
Avoid standard picture posts ('pic') on general cultural or domestic political news (e.g., Diwali lights, House Democrat impeachment), as they yield zero engagement.

news.summary: Aap ke page par Reels sab se zyada reach aur performance de rahi hain (228 avg score), jab ke simple photo posts aur generic breaking news ka result bohot kam hai. Urdu zaban mein posts English ke muqable mein behtar chal rahi hain, aur Science/Tech aur Business ke topics sab se zyada views le rahe hain. Hum ne acha perform karne wale topics ka ratio barha diya hai aur mashwara hai ke posts ko Shaam 4 PM se Raat 1 AM PKT (11:00-20:00 UTC) ke darmiyan upload karein.
